note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 7313 Section 4 ('or in response to a "normal route refresh request" from the peer, the speaker MUST send a BoRR message.') and {single-polarity: positive} after RFC 7313 completion (443c6ef1d1) and diagnostic-code constant move (f4a0df7781). In RIBManager.handleRefreshStructured, subtype 0 still calls queueSelectedRefresh unchanged (subtypes 1 and 2 now dispatch received BoRR/EoRR handling). In queueSelectedRefresh and replayLegacyRefresh, only diagnostic.CodeDoctorBGPSelectedOutput was moved to package-local codeDoctorBGPSelectedOutput; replayLegacyRefresh still executes BoRR, sendRoutes, EoRR in straight-line order, and selectedRefreshRun runs selectedRefreshBegin before selectedRefreshRoutes/selectedRefreshConfigured/selectedRefreshEnd. All four tagged test units (TestRouteRefreshSubtypes, TestRFC7313BoRRRoutesEoRRInOneSequence, TestRFC7313RefreshBracketsReadvertisementWithBoRRAndEoRR, TestDispatchBGPPeerBoRR) and handleRefresh/sendRoutes/currentRefreshSession/collectRibOutRoutes are byte-identical. Locally initiated refresh is separately covered by RFC7313-4-13.
